sentences.text: This fixed-rate term loan to a non-individual borrower is outside the specific pre-payment charge prohibitions for floating-rate loans and the individual/MSE categories, so the residual rule applies instead.

For those other cases, the in-force RBI direction says pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the bank’s policy states a 2% foreclosure charge on non-individual corporate term loans.

So, on the evidence provided, a 2% foreclosure charge does not conflict with the cited RBI pre-payment rule for UCBs, but the charge also must be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and the evidence does not show whether that disclosure was made.

missing.slot: approved policy / sanction documents showing whether the 2% charge was disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement
missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force RBI pre-payment directions for UCBs and the bank policy excerpts provided.
